title: One chair
logline: Christmas Eve on the dock: string lights, and Maria's lawn chair, alone, facing the water. One chair. Three years before there are two.

margin.note: The crab, small, beside the word.

panels.composition: The dock at night strung with lights, an old lawn chair alone on the planks facing the water, the shack's window warm, the bay black.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wooden dock at night strung with colored lights with a single old lawn chair facing the water, a shingle shack's window glowing, black bay beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
